title: [Main] Fix unbalanced G/L when a Credit Memo is applied to a rejected/redraw…
summary: Fixed an issue where applying a sales credit memo to a rejected or redrawn bill in the Spanish (Cartera) version caused the Rejected Bills Account to become unbalanced due to duplicate posting.
key_points: Credit memos applied to rejected bills now post the Rejected Bills Account reclassification only once instead of twice
Prevents duplicate posting by skipping application posting in PostDtldCustApplicationEntry when PostReceivableDocs already handles the rejected bill
Ensures the Rejected Bills Account clears correctly and transactions remain balanced
Includes test coverage for the cartera redraw scenario
